items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: And then after they got blue but he couldn't read no music. You remember blue?

ctx.x: Did they read much or was it mostly by ear?

Did they read much music or mostly by ear? Oh yeah, especially down there was plenty of music from his wedding. And then after they got blue but he couldn't read no music. You remember blue? Yeah. Yeah, he got dead in a parade run.
Who was the clarinet with Wesley Dimes? How was he? No, clarinet. Who was the clarinet player with Wesley Dimes?
